name: Fashion Komyushou-kun
original_name: ファッションコミュ障くん
source:
A young man working part-time at a convenience store. He is unsociable, masochistic, and full of pride.

He is always stressed out because he worries about things that most people don't care about.

[translated from [url=https://3on10.com/fashion/]official site[/url]]
